title: Modern Tech Madhubani Hybrid Visual Aesthetics Standard
description: Art direction combining ancient Mithila folk art linework with sleek modern Indian engineering environments.

positive_invariants.contours: crisp double line black ink linework
positive_invariants.eyes: distinctive sharp almond shaped eyes filled with intensity
positive_invariants.color_palette: flat saturated gouache fills in indigo, mustard turmeric, terracotta, copper orange, and sandstone cream
positive_invariants.decorative_patterns: kachni cross hatching and bharni solid fill patterns on architectural arches and fabric borders
positive_invariants.modern_props: open slim laptops, optical mice, modern smartphones, server cloisters, cutting chai in faceted glass glasses with brass holders
positive_invariants.lighting: warm Indian sunlight, courtyard sandstone shadows, golden twilight

prohibited_elements: crude stick figures or generic vector clipart
Devanagari or Hindi text inside illustrations
AI watermarks or Gemini logo artifacts
